title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical portra
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, seated at a café table in a warm, intimate indoor setting. She has a petite, softly rounded oval face with delicate facial proportions, naturally full cheeks, a gently tapered jawline, a small straight nose with a softly rounded tip, and naturally pink, subtly glossy lips. Her complexion is fair and luminous with warm peach-pink undertones, a gentle rosy flush across her cheeks, delicate skin texture, and realistic soft highlights. Her large, dark brown almond-shaped eyes have clear, expressive pupils, subtle catchlights, naturally defined upper eyelashes, understated eyeliner, and a tender, attentive gaze directed straight toward the camera. Her expression is sweet, relaxed, and slightly playful, with a faint closed-mouth smile.

Her hair is dark chocolate brown, nearly black, silky and straight, styled with wispy, slightly separated bangs falling across her forehead just above her eyebrows. The remaining hair is loosely gathered toward the back, with a few fine strands softly framing her cheeks and jawline.

She has a naturally feminine, softly curvaceous figure with a slender frame, a defined waist, and a full bust proportionate to her body. She sits close to the edge of a glossy, cream-colored café table, leaning her upper body slightly forward toward the camera. Her right elbow rests on the tabletop, with her right hand gently touching the side of her face near her ear and cheek. Her head tilts subtly toward her supporting hand, while her left arm extends diagonally toward the lower-right foreground, partially disappearing beyond the frame.

She wears a fitted, lightweight white ribbed-knit long-sleeve top with delicate vertical ribbing, slightly translucent fabric texture, subtle scalloped lettuce-edge cuffs, and a softly scalloped, low-cut rounded neckline revealing her upper chest and natural cleavage. The garment follows her natural silhouette without appearing exaggerated. A fine gold chain necklace with a tiny sparkling teardrop pendant rests just above her cleavage. No additional clothing, accessories, or outerwear are visible.

The setting is a cozy café or lounge featuring warm exposed red-brick walls on the left, muted green foliage, dark upholstered seating, and a softly blurred window in the background revealing cool blue evening lights. Warm amber overhead illumination blends with gentle diffuse frontal lighting, producing flattering skin tones, smooth shadow transitions, and subtle reflections across the tabletop.

Captured from a close, slightly elevated, front-facing perspective using a full-frame camera and a 35mm portrait lens at f/1.8, with shallow depth of field, precise eye focus, realistic skin details, soft cinematic bokeh, natural facial proportions, and authentic photographic texture. Warm caramel and muted brown color grading balanced with cool blue background accents, delicate highlight roll-off, intimate lifestyle photography aesthetic, high dynamic range, professional editorial quality, ultra-photorealistic rendering, no text, no logos, no watermarks. Aspect ratio 3:4.
